commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+6' David Neres (Napoli) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his low drive to the right post is smartly dealt with by Emil Audero.
90+5' Nico Paz (Como) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
90+3' Rough tackle by Nico Paz (Como). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+3' Wonderful movement by Como. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

66' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Como are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.

31' Napoli take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

25' It looked like the long-range shot by Nico Paz (Como) would end up in the net, but the effort went painfully wide of the left post. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.

19' Patrick Cutrone (Como) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
17' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
14' Napoli are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
12' Patrick Cutrone (Como) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
11' Nico Paz (Como) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
8' Sergi Roberto (Como) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
